summary.text: Two distinct outages occurred in March 2026: INC-031 on 2 March lasted 75 minutes and was caused by an expired edge gateway TLS certificate, while INC-032 on 4 March lasted 45 minutes and was caused by a failed rollback of CHG-441. The two incidents had different root causes and together caused 15,500 failed customer transactions. The executive email's single-event description is not supported by the incident records, and the draft remediation plan remains unapproved.

summary.text: As of 15 June 2026, signed Amendment A controls EU retention for accounts opened on or after 1 January 2026, setting 18 months effective 1 March 2026. Accounts opened before 1 January 2026 remain at 12 months under the EU Retention Addendum. The system-of-record export shows 12 months and is stale for accounts opened on or after 1 January 2026, and the public trust page snapshot also shows 12 months. Draft Amendment B has no effect, and backup retention is 35 days outside the Enterprise Data Retention Policy.
